# Core Rules

Use routing to decide whether to answer directly, inspect files, run tests, or invoke the reviewer.

Autonomy: make low-risk local reads and edits, but request approval for destructive work.

Context: summarize long findings before continuing and keep only current task facts.

Error handling: fail loud when commands fail, inputs are missing, or verification cannot be completed.

Self-learning: write retro notes for repeated issues and update the harness after validated patterns emerge.
